description: constraints.npm: lock files are written with npm 11, like CI (build-base) and web/.nvmrc. npm 12 (allow-remote=none) cannot update a lock file that holds a bundleDependencies package such as @tailwindcss/oxide-wasm32-wasi (npm/cli#9800); drop the constraint once that is fixed.

packageRules.description: Go major versions change the module path and need a code migration; never automerge them.
Keeps constraints.npm on 11: Renovate raised it to 12 on its own (#232) and every web lock file update failed again with EALLOWREMOTE. Drop together with the constraint once npm/cli#9800 is fixed.
SvelteKit majors and its adapters only work together.
The build-base image floats on its major tag by design; downstream repos pull :1.
